subject: E-Commerce
title: MercadoLibre: Latin America's Amazon
description: A quick win: understand MercadoLibre: Latin America's Amazon.

hook.text: MercadoLibre is worth more than any Latin American bank. It started as an eBay clone in an Argentine garage.

buildup.text: Latin America had fragmented currencies, unreliable postal services, and low credit card adoption.

discovery.text: MercadoLibre built its own payment system (MercadoPago) and logistics network to solve infrastructure gaps.

twist.text: MercadoPago is now bigger than MercadoLibre's marketplace. The payment arm became the main business.

climax.text: Building infrastructure where none existed created a moat no competitor could easily cross.

punchline.text: Garage eBay clone became Latin America's most valuable company. Build wins.
